INSERT INTO photos(id,short_id,album_id,title,original_hash,original_name,original_bytes,mime,kind,width,height,sort_order)
              SELECT id,short,$3,'Album benchmark',$4,'fixture.mp4',1,'video/mp4',
                CASE WHEN n%5=0 THEN 'video'::media_kind ELSE 'image'::media_kind END,1920,1080,n::int
              FROM unnest($1::uuid[],$2::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY t(id,short,n)
